translation.name: Di Nyoo Testiment eena Bileez Kriol
translation.englishName: New Testament in Belize Kriol English (BH:bzj:Belize Kriol English)

content: Wach yu mowt!
Mi bradaz ahn sistaz, wahn lata unu shudn chrai fi bee teecha, kaa unu noa dat Gaad wahn joj aala wi weh di teech haada dahn evribadi els.
Da chroo dat aala wi slip dong eena difrent kaina way evri now ahn agen. If enibadi ku kanchroal dehn tong, den dehn perfek, ahn dehn ku kanchroal di hoal a dehn badi.
Unu si how gud wi ku kanchroal wahn haas ahn mek ih obay wen wi put wahn bit eena ih mowt?
Er luk pahn wahn ship. Unu si how big ih big, ahn how schrang breez kehr ahn? Bot stilyet di kyaptin ku kanchroal it wid wahn lee, lee roda, ahn mek ih goh eniway weh hihn waahn.
Rait soh, di tong da wahn lee pees a wi badi, bot ih oanli bregin ahn boasi. Luk how wahn big bush faiya ku staat fahn wahn lee lee spaak.

Ahn di tong da wahn faiya tu. Ih deh rait deh monks di ada paats a di badi, bot ih ful op a wikidnis weh ku mes op di hoal a wahn persn ahn kaaz wahn blayz weh ku dischrai di hoal a dehn laif. Ih geh da faiya schrayt fahn hel.
Man taym aal kaina animal ahn berd ahn reptail ahn ting weh deh eena di see.
Bot nobadi kyaahn taym di tong. Da ting wikid bad, ahn ih ful op a paizn weh ku kil yu ded!
Wi yooz wi tong fi prayz wi Laad ahn Faada, ahn den wi ton rong ahn yooz di sayhn tong fi kos peepl weh Gaad mek laik fi hihn oanself.
Imajin, prayz ahn kosin di kom owta di sayhn mowt! Mi bradaz ahn sistaz, dis noh rait, yu noh!
Wat? Fresh waata ahn saalt waata ku kom owta di sayhn wel?
Mi bradaz ahn sistaz, wahn fig chree ku bayr aliv, er wahn grayp-vain ku bayr fig? Rait soh, wahn saalt waata wel kyaahn gi yu fresh waata.
Gud sens da fahn Gaad
Enibadi deh monks unu weh waiz ahn ga gud sens? Mek dehn shoa it bai di way dehn liv. Dehn mos smaat nof fi noh prayz op dehn oanself wen dehn du sohnting.
Bot if yu grojful ahn ga red aiy, ahn oanli kansaan bowt yuself, yu noh fi boas bowt it. Dat da noh di rait way.
Datdeh kaina “wizdom” noh kohn fahn Gaad. Ih kohn fahn disya werl ahn di devl.
Wentaim yu si peepl red aiy ahn oanli tink bowt dehn oanself, yu wahn fain kanfyoozhan ahn aal kaina wikidnis di goh aan.

Bot di fos ting bowt di wizdom weh kohn fahn Gaad, ih kleen kleen. Ih lov pees ahn ih kansidarayt; ih noa ih plays ahn ih ful a mersi ahn ih du kain tingz fi peepl. Ih chreet evribadi di sayhn way, ahn ih da fi reel.
Evribadi weh help mek pees monks ada peepl di plaant di seed a pees, ahn dehn wahn reep wahn lata gud tingz fahn dat.
